facts.fact: The Central Statistical Office released the Annual Vital Statistics Report January-December 2022, drawn from the National Population Register, in October 2023; it covers 2022 and reports birth registration completeness of 36% (31% in 2021) and death registration completeness of 55% (75% in 2021).
The 2022 report is stated to be the seventh in a series of annual CRVS reports produced since 2016, released October 2023, and the foreword says producing the annual report is a continuous process.
